description: Hi!I am an Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning(AIML) student with a keen interest in technology,programming,AI and space exploration.I enjoy learning new technologies, solving problems and exploring creative ideas.I am excited to participate in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to gain practical experience,improve my technical skills and collaborate with others.I look forward to contributing my knowledge and learning new things while building an innovative Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer.
summary: The Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an educational program that helps students learn about space and astronaut activities. It provides knowledge about planets, stars, rockets, spacecraft and the solar system. Students learn how astronauts prepare for space missions and work in space. It also develops teamwork, discipline, confidence and problem-solving skills. Through different activities and simulations, students gain practical knowledge about space exploration. This program creates interest in science and technology and inspires young students to become future astronauts.
details: The Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an educational and interactive learning program designed to introduce students to the world of astronauts and space exploration. It helps young students understand how astronauts prepare for space missions and perform different activities in space.
